x2_invariants_must_prove: exactly ONE canonical SH-WTP RuntimeSession exists (workspace 'shwtp', one active run id) and no second run/session authority is created by any scope, controller or UI
no new RuntimeSession / RunLifecycleService / ExecutionBridge / engine construction beyond the existing canonical one
each X2 executable scope instantiates its declared process contract family (no invented topology or interfaces)
volume/mass balance: for every storage scope dV/dt = inflow - outflow is respected to numerical tolerance; the plant-level balance oracle reports its residual
bounded outputs: no negative volume/flow, every state stays within its declared constraints, and clamps raise a labelled VF alarm
causal monotonicity: DP non-decreasing between backwashes; filtered turbidity <= settled turbidity; no effect precedes its cause within a window
determinism: identical initial conditions + identical input sequence produce identical trajectories; no wall-clock or unordered-iteration dependence
no same-window feed-through under the existing explicit_lagged coupling policy
all C1 controls active exactly as listed in x2_c1_controls_active; NO C2 loop active (no PI/PID evaluation, no scan loop)
every assumed edge in use carries its assumption_id in the runtime provenance and appears in the UI 'assumed topology' list; no assumed edge is ever presented as PIM-known
T106/T108 existing accepted semantics preserved (G13/G13B/G21/G22 behaviour unchanged: T108 first_order tank, T106 logical pass-through, F01 projection, 2-participant federation, evaluation rows)
site_truth=false and simulation_truth=synthetic_reference on every payload; vf_runtime_authorization stays NOT_AUTHORIZED
deterministic contract load: the graph/process/control/admission artefacts load to an identical signature across runs
no new PIM canonical id is referenced that does not already exist in the accepted PIM-derived inventory/graph

X1-C01: every process input of an X2-admitted scope is produced inside X2 by an X2-active C1 control, a process node, the scenario boundary or an explicit declared X2 fallback/default; NO admitted scope consumes a C2 controller output in X2

X1-C01: level-driven actions name the correct actuator direction - a low/low-low level protects DOWNSTREAM withdrawal while upstream refill stays permitted, and a high/high-high level inhibits UPSTREAM intake while downstream withdrawal stays permitted
